answer: A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The garden counter is kept in raven and jade shows each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1012 identities would post 3481 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
